run_pipeline_qwenimage_edit_inpaint: run the QwenImageEditInpaintPipeline to inpaint an image with a text prompt and mask
encode_prompt_qwenimage: encode a text prompt with an image into prompt embeddings using the Qwen2.5-VL text encoder
prepare_latents_inpaint: prepare latent variables for inpainting by encoding the source image and applying noise at a given timestep
prepare_mask_latents: prepare mask and masked image latents by resizing the mask and encoding the masked image for inpainting
calculate_shift_qwenimage: calculate the shift parameter for the scheduler based on image sequence length and scaling bounds
